releases.name: Final Kick Football Legends
releases.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

releases.name: Danger Mouse
releases.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

releases.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
releases.summary:
Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

He-Man, Teela, and Man-At-Arms do battle over 12 sprawling and diverse levels of non-stop action, armed with a host of moves, abilities, and power-ups as they work to stop Skeletor’s ancient ritual that threatens to plunge Eternia into darkness!

releases.name: Monochrome Echoes - white -
releases.summary:
A world of only "white" and "black" where swords and magic hold power.

During the time of the Ancient Empire, the Demon King was sealed away by a summoned "hero" from another world. However, the seal was not complete, and it must be resealed every 200 years.

The "Clan of the Sealers" who govern this periodically summon the hero.

And when it is time for the resealing for the umpteenth time, "you" are summoned from another world.

This is the story of an adventure in the "Archipelago of Ruins" where the Demon King sleeps.

releases.name: Cat Me If You Can
releases.summary: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

releases.name: Bulbo's Belief System
releases.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

releases.name: KYOTO XANADU -the Blooming Phantom-
releases.summary:
The mysterious giant labyrinth known as Xanadu lies beneath the high school. As a student, you will challenge the labyrinth.

Deepening bonds with various people during your daily life in Kyoto city and growing through battles within Xanadu, you will uncover the truth hidden within both the labyrinth and Kyoto itself.

releases.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
releases.summary:
A sudden Titan attack prompts massive evacuation efforts-but not everyone makes it to safety before the devastation ensues. Caught in the crossfire between battling monsters, many residents become trapped in the collapsing city - your only daughter among them!

Kong: Survivor Instinct is a 2.5D action-adventure game that combines realistic platforming, challenging combat, and metroidvania-style exploration during a thrilling quest of survival worthy of the Monsterverse franchise.

releases.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection
releases.summary: THE BREED IS BACK! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

releases.name: Chromascape
releases.summary:
Explore a cozy, hand-drawn world where color brings life back! Join Luna the hedgehog in a heartwarming 2D adventure filled with puzzles.

Chromascape is a top-down 2D adventure set in a soft, atmospheric world where you solve puzzles using the power of "color."

■ Palette Planet: A World Sustained by Color

On Palette Planet, the flowers, the trees, and the residents themselves once lived in the embrace of color.
But now, a phenomenon known as the "Color Loss" has begun.
As the colors slowly fade from the world, the residents have also started to disappear without a trace.

■ Receive and Share

One day, Luna the hedgehog discovers she holds a special power.
With this gift, she can restore hues to objects that have lost them and reactivate dormant forces.
Throughout her journey, she uses this power to bring life back to her surroundings.

■ Journey with Friends

The companions you meet along the way all possess unique talents.
By borrowing their strength and working together, Luna can overcome obstacles and reach places she could never explore alone.

■ A Gentle Adventure Woven by Color

Warm colors may become fire to light up the darkness.
Cool colors might freeze flowing water to create a new path.
Deciding which color to bestow, and where, is the key to solving the puzzles.

releases.name: King's Blade
releases.summary:
Step into a grim world of heroic fantasy with King's Blade - a classic Beat 'em up inspired by the universe of Conan the Barbarian and legendary arcade titles like Golden Axe and Streets of Rage.

Take command of the elite warriors of the King's Blade and fight your way through the hordes of the Barganian Empire! Crush enemies in epic brawls, traverse deadly lands, and carve a path to the heart of the enemy capital.

Join forces with friends in local co-op for up to 4 players, or add AI fighters to your team!

releases.name: The Merlies
releases.summary:
The Merlies, a community of tiny birds, got scattered across the land by a huge storm! Explore a colorful charming 2D universe and unlock new hidden passages as your Merlies squad grows and learns new skills, in a metroidvania-like gameplay. Use each Merlies’ specific abilities during your exploration in this poetic adventure game.

While being beautiful, the world of The Merlies isn’t the most welcoming one. Your Merlies remain fragile little fellows exposed to the dangers of Nature. No creature or fight will be on your way but every thorn, every rock, every tree becomes an obstacle to overcome. Sometimes, the path will be hard to find, hidden in this wild and bucolic maze. And be careful not to lose one of your Merlies on the way!

Throughout your exploration, you’ll encounter remains of a long gone civilization. Lucky you! For one man’s junk is a Merlies’ treasure! Collect scraps to create and decorate your village, accommodate your Merlies and train them to get ready for exploration!

releases.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
releases.summary:
A hero’s work is never done! Disorder is brewing, and the world stands before a threat unlike any other. A new danger is growing in power, ready to descend upon the land and unleash mayhem.

Return to the world of Minecraft Dungeons in an all‑new action RPG adventure, brimming with high‑stakes encounters, thrilling challenges, and never‑before‑seen locations, as you set out to save a world in crisis. Will you and your allies prevail against the forces of evil and save the day once more?

releases.name: Dicevaders
releases.summary: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

releases.name: Blades & Battles
releases.summary:
Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

The game features 2 playable characters: Arthur and Lancelot, with their own skill sets and sword fighting styles.

Filled with beautiful scenery and cinematic interactive moments, it's an immersive, action-packed experience of chivalry, honor and adventure.

releases.name: TOEM 2
releases.summary:
Ready your camera and set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2!

Tie those sneakers and ready your camera, it’s time to set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2! Head off on a relaxing journey, spurred on by your newly-awakened passion for discovering and photographing mysterious “events” known as TOEMs. TOEM 2 was crafted to be welcoming for both returning fans of TOEM and those who want to jump in for the first time.

Explore: Run, jump, and climb your way through all-new cozy environments, uncovering hidden paths, scenic viewpoints, and small details waiting to be discovered. The world is built to reward curiosity, so take your time and wander wherever your camera leads you.

Meet: Encounter a cast of new quirky characters and adorable critters along your journey. Lend a hand to new faces, create lasting friendships, and catalogue your memories as you go along.

Snap: Your camera has gotten an upgrade! Not only can you snap pictures to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and document your discoveries, you can also use them in more unconventional ways, with new attachments letting you overcome various problems in each region.

Stamp: Fill your journal with stamps as you complete quests, document discoveries, and expand your critter compendium. Each stamp is not only a reminder of the little wonders you’ve uncovered along the way — they’re also your ticket to unlocking the next region.

Set Your Pace: TOEM 2 is built to be experienced at your own pace with no time limits or tricky requirements for full completion. Listen to music on a bench, smell the flowers, admire the sights and enjoy.

releases.name: Keep Driving
releases.summary: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

releases.name: Larcin Lazer
releases.summary: Larcin Lazer is a puzzle game in which your memory is put to the test. Each level is filled with lasers that disappear as soon as you start moving. Move discreetly, relying on your memory to get to the end of the course. Be careful, lasers are not the only dangers standing in your way!

releases.name: Scritchy Scratchy
releases.summary:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

releases.name: Counter Protocol: Origins
releases.summary:
Join the SWAT. Take back the city. Save the hostages.

The city is in chaos. You are the response.

In Counter Protocol: Origins, step into the boots of an elite SWAT officer and take on the most dangerous operations in a city overrun by armed gangs and violent criminals.

Clear hostile locations, breach criminal hideouts, survive intense firefights, and push through enemy territory to rescue innocent hostages. Every mission demands focus, fast reactions, and the courage to keep moving when the odds are against you.

Pick from a variety of firearms, adapt to each combat situation, and face threats waiting around every corner. From close-quarters encounters to dangerous enemy strongholds, every operation puts your skills to the test.

The mission is clear: neutralize the threat, save the innocent, and restore order.

Key Features:
- Play as an elite SWAT officer in intense tactical shooter action
- Take on high-risk missions against armed criminals and gangs
- Clear dangerous locations and storm enemy-controlled strongholds
- Rescue hostages in tense, action-packed operations
- Choose from a variety of firearms for different combat situations
- Test your reflexes in fast-paced first-person combat

releases.name: Missed Class: Horror
releases.summary:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
releases.summary:
Make your way through an icy obstacle course filled with slippery platforms, long jumps and freezing hazards. Stay focused as you leap across floating platforms and avoid falling into the frozen abyss.

Want a real challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One slip, and it's back to the beginning.
